function.name: UNLOAD_WAV
function.param: Identifier of the sound returned by LOAD_WAV
function.abstract: It unloads the memory occupied for a sound effect

description.p: It eliminates a sound effect of memory. It is important that the effect is not playing when we use this function, so that you must check it using the function . Normally only it is necessary to unload of memory sound effects which never stops, or occupies more space, like the engine of a car or the rain of background, so this limitation will not be advisable because it is necessary of all ways to take a control of the reproduction of this sound.
